episode_summary: This episode of Keeping It Real features a coaching session with Michael Opyd, who helps real estate agent David Farrell tackle the challenges of scaling his business while managing multiple commitments. Key insights include the importance of prioritizing tasks that align with long-term goals and using automated systems to maintain client relationships. The discussion emphasizes self-awareness and personal growth as essential components for achieving business success.
